text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, all done.
It's a shame, but why don't you give up?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I don't see any reason to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I told ya from the start, I'm not interested.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*, don't look so down.
Come on, let's head back.
It ended in a disappointing result...
